text:
Nora (Product): quick check 0min - we committed to Orbit pilot with BYOK and a quantized model fallback. need a clear acceptance gating matrix and which teams own each gate. timeline: customer asked for a 4-5 week pilot.
Sam (PM): acceptance matrix we discussed: 1) p99 latency target, 2) BYOK rotate test, 3) token burn under budget, 4) canary window + rollback. want to map owners.
Ivy (Runtime): runtime owns prewarm hooks, health endpoint, and fallback wiring to hosted quantized variant. prewarm depends on infra signals and KMS availability. estimate 2.5w for integration + tests.
Rahul (Infra): infra owns VPC peering, reserved GPU quota, and network rules for KMS/HSM. quota approvals are likely the longest lead (5-10 bd). peering can start in parallel but final CIDR bind waits on security.
Dana (Security): BYOK review is gating. need vendor attestation, rotation/expiry policy, and an audit log plan. estimate ~7 bd once we have vendor packet. also need a minimal threat model for peering.
Ben (Eng): engineering effort for product-facing toggle and automated acceptance test harness ~2w. can run tests against mocked KMS endpoints while security review runs.
Ava (SRE): SRE owns canary policy and runbook. proposal: 2% traffic for 30m, monitor p50/p95/p99 and token cost delta. Auto-fallback if p99 > threshold for 10m. need token-level logs to validate burn.
Sam (PM): critical path appears to be: vendor attestation -> quota approvals -> runtime integration -> staging canary. parallelize where possible.
Nora (Product): plan: Dana start security packet immediately; Rahul open quota + peering tickets; Ivy/Ben spike mocks now.
ticket-bot: Created ticket INFRA-ORBIT-619 by Rahul.
Rahul (Infra): ticket created and linked here. pinging cloud-ops for quota bump.
Ivy (Runtime): spike posted: https://redwood.internal/spikes/orbit-prewarm (includes health endpoint: GET /t/{id}/warm -> "warm":true|false).
Ben (Eng): posted test harness branch and a lightweight canary script.
Dana (Security): received vendor packet from Orbit. starting attestation review today.
Ava (SRE): drafting runbook; will include automatic rollback policy and incident thresholds.
Sam (PM): small ask: call out any strictly serial blockers that would prevent overlap.
Dana (Security): vendor attestation is serial for peering creds. if vendor delays, peering can't be approved.
Rahul (Infra): cloud quota increase may be serial if account approvals are required. tagging cloud-ops now.
Nora (Product): action items recap: Dana: attestation review (7bd). Rahul: quota + peering tickets (3bd prep). Ivy/Ben: mock prewarm + tests (EOW). Ava: runbook stub (2bd). Sam/Nora: finalize acceptance matrix and token budget with customer (2bd). react with :white_check_mark: when you ack.
